english.title: Club Secretary not notify change of club name / alteration to rules - Licensing
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the secretary of a club, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..), which

(A)_[held a club premises certificate,]_
(B)_[had made an application for a club premises certificate which had not been determined by the licensing authority, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AUTHORITY..),]_

failed within twenty eight days to notify the licensing authority of a decision made on **(..SPECIFY THE DATE..) to

(C)_[change the name of the club]_
(D)_[alter the club rules]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 82 of the Licensing Act 2003.
